title: Etaleness at a prime descends for a faithfully flat field base change
statement: Let k be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K/k a field extension, A a commutative k-algebra, and B a finitely presented A-algebra [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let q be a prime of B, put p=q\cap A, let B_K=B\otimes_k K [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-base-change-universal-property], and let q_K be a prime of B_K whose contraction to B is q. If B_K is etale over A\otimes_k K at q_K in the standard pointwise sense (that is, Algebra.IsEtaleAt (A\otimes_k K) q_K; equivalently, since B_K is finitely presented over A\otimes_k K, the localization (B_K)_{q_K} is flat over A\otimes_k K and the module of relative differentials of B_K over A\otimes_k K vanishes after localizing at q_K), then B is etale over A at q in the same standard sense (Algebra.IsEtaleAt A q).
